implemented: Seeded session setup, generated town graph, and route distances.
Town rendering, persistent per-session town placement, and travel.
Case-file generation, wanted notices, typed event history, and projections.
Replay and the developer audit surface.
transitional: Visual polish, town tiling, and broader gameplay.
Entropy behaviour beyond the deterministic path, layout-inspection reliability, and some developer-control integrations.
planned: Public accounts and sessions, production hosting, player-facing seed sharing, game balance, and a supportable public demo.
